title: Cross-session messaging
description: Claude Code sessions can now message each other on macOS and Linux, enabling Claude to pass findings and decisions between sessions instead of requiring re-explanation. Introduces ListAgents and SendMessage tools for coordinating work across terminals and worktrees.

community_feedback.quote: It's Claude code talking to another Claude code. With tmux, a memory tree, and handoff files and an orchestrator, agents can talk cross harness.
Particularly useful when changes in one session impact work in another session.

title: Self-hosted environments in public beta
description: Self-hosted environments run Claude Code cloud sessions on infrastructure your organization operates, now in public beta on Team and Enterprise plans.

title: Auto mode becomes default
description: Auto mode becomes the default permission mode for new sessions on Pro, Max, and Team plans starting August 14.

title: Copilot memory and JetBrains features
description: New Copilot memory features and Ollama integration in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains. Copilot Memory helps the assistant become more effective by remembering facts about repositories and personal coding preferences across workflows.

community_feedback.quote: GitHub Copilot now remembers what it learns across your workflow. Copilot coding agent, CLI, and code review share knowledge automatically.
Copilot is worse than useless - consistently ignores highest level instructions

title: Copilot enterprise management tools
description: New enterprise management tools and administration capabilities for Copilot.

title: v0.54.0 stable release - Enhanced Authentication & Security
description: Latest stable release with enhanced authentication and security features, core functionality updates, sandbox improvements, and Vertex updates including Cloud Run webhook ingestion, path and symlink features.

title: v0.55.0-preview.1 with experimental features
description: Preview release including latest new and experimental features for early adopters.

title: Google Workspace Plugins
description: Cursor can now read, write, and act across your Google Workspace with plugins for Gmail, Google Drive, and Google Calendar. Enables coding agents to pull context, draft and update files, and manage inbox and calendar without leaving Cursor.

title: Cursor Router with optimization modes
description: Cursor Router is an intelligent model router that analyzes requests and sends them to the right model with Intelligence, Balance, and Cost optimization modes. Frontier models handle demanding work while price-efficient models handle the rest.

title: Cursor Start plan for India
description: New ₹649 monthly plan for developers in India with local pricing and UPI payment, including Grok 4.5 models, cloud agents, Cursor for iOS with remote control, and plugins/MCP/skills support.

title: Portable Agent Plugins and conversation organization
description: New features including portable Agent Plugins, plugin catalogs searchable across local and personal workspace, and conversation organization into persistent sessions.

title: MCP support and Amazon Bedrock integration
description: Added MCP support from July 28 and Amazon Bedrock integration for expanded connectivity.

title: Claude 4.5/4.6 and Gemini 2.5 Flash support
description: Added support for Claude 4.5/4.6 models with updated sonnet/haiku/opus aliases, expanded Gemini model support including 2.5 Flash and Flash-Lite, and added Gemini 3 preview models.

title: DeepSeek Reasoner and language support
description: Added DeepSeek Reasoner model with updated metadata and costs, repo map now supports Fortran, Haskell, Julia, and Zig languages, and is compatible with newer tree-sitter Python APIs.

title: August 2026 updates
description: Recent Windsurf updates for August 2026 including Cascade agent improvements, enhanced AI integration, and feature updates.
